mission: Technical-SEO sweep of the RENDERED site in public/: titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, JSON-LD schema, H1 discipline, image alt coverage, sitemap/robots health, and broken internal links. Mechanical facts with commands as evidence.
parent_objective: SQ-068 full content/SEO/quality audit of utilityexplained.com
context: Read .squad/SQ-068/audit-criteria.md FIRST (binding rubric). public/ is the fully rendered Hugo site (fresh 2026-08-29). All pages are .html files or dirs with index.html. Quote every path (repo path has a space). Do NOT invoke scripts/squad.py — write your own grep/awk loops.
known_facts: 110 content pages exist in content/; public/blog/ has ~112 rendered entries
constraints: Read-only vs the repo — no writes anywhere
Every finding must cite the command that produced it
success_criteria: Title-tag report: count, length distribution (under 30 / 30-60 / over 60 chars), duplicate titles
Meta-description report: missing count, duplicate count, over-160-char count, 3 worst examples quoted
Canonical report: pages lacking rel=canonical (count + list)
Schema report: which JSON-LD @types appear, on how many pages (grep -c evidence); pages missing schema entirely
H1 report: pages with zero or multiple <h1>
Image alt report: rendered without alt attribute (count + 5 examples with page path)
Sitemap: total URLs (grep -c <loc>), any content page missing from sitemap; robots.txt contents summarized
Internal-link integrity: extract hrefs starting / from public/**/*.html, report any target that does not resolve to an existing file/dir on disk (list up to 30, with count)
